field_notes.basis_spread: Identifier values are stated as percentages, for example S + 6.25%; no bps literals are embedded in the sampled identifiers.
field_notes.interest_rate: Identifier values are stated as percentages after Interest Rate; one sample omits the percent sign after 8.92, so the regex allows an optional percent sign.
field_notes.pik_rate: PIK is optional and appears inside '(incl. X% PIK)' for inclusive all-in spread wording, or as 'X% PIK' where the PIK value is not safely distinguishable from basis_spread.
field_notes.maturity_date: Debt identifiers state Maturity Date in M/D/YYYY or MM/DD/YYYY form.
field_notes.old_era_investment_rows: Older INVESTMENT samples may have rate twins, but the identifier strings only carry issuer and tranche/index; those rates are not identifier-embedded datapoints.

evidence: Bundle DEBT INVESTMENT INVESTMENT samples for 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, and 2026-03-31 embed Reference Rate and Spread, optional incl. PIK, Interest Rate, and Maturity Date.

Bundle DEBT INVESTMENT samples use the same embedded debt rate/date format, including S + spread, Interest Rate, and Maturity Date, but the validator accepts one applies_to signature object, so this proposal scopes to the dominant DEBT INVESTMENT INVESTMENT signature.

Bundle older INVESTMENT samples across 2023-03-31 through 2025-06-30 carry issuer-only or issuer-plus-tranche identifiers such as Associations, Inc. 1 and Firebird Acquisition Corp, Inc. 1 even when structured twins have rates, so those source-column rates are not used as identifier grammar fields.
